raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 has 354 rows but its txn_id range covers only 334 ids, and its ingest_ts (22:00 on 2026-01-17) is off-schedule, so it appears to replay about 20 already-loaded transactions. Silver keeps every copy, which causes the duplicate keys and double-counts the gold tables. The fix keeps only the earliest-ingested POSTED copy of each txn_id, assuming replayed copies are identical, which the evidence does not show.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
